description: Found during the fz-kdt.86 cold review (2026-08-31). function_declares_contract (world.rs:1131) returns false for FunctionState::Placeholder | Noted -- an undefined function is reported as DECLARING NO CONTRACT rather than UNKNOWN (violates unknown-is-not-none). call_emission_for_function (semantic.rs:1228) has no wait_for_unresolved_function_module guard (the other two resolve sites have it at :1301/:1448), so a not-yet-defined callee silently resolves contract-free there. Masked today only because require_activation_key_facts blocks two statements later. Make it correct by construction: either the predicate returns a three-state answer (declares / declares-nothing / undefined => wait), or the definedness guard is folded into fz-kdt.86's require_callee_prerequisites so all three sites share one gate. Verify with a fixture where a callee's module resolves late.
title: function_declares_contract answers 'declares nothing' for UNDEFINED functions -- safe by accident, not construction
